description:
MCP guidance:
- Starts an async audio job; returns `id` and `credits_charged`. For finished results, call `wait_for_audio_project` with that id or poll `GET /v1/audio-projects/{id}` until `complete`, `error`, or `canceled`. Results include `downloads`; wait helpers add `exact_download_urls`. Preserve signed URLs and query parameters; never append expiration metadata.
- For `*_file_path`, use an existing Magic Hour path or the upload-URL endpoint's `file_path` after uploading raw bytes to its presigned URL. Direct public media URLs may work if stable and fetchable as raw bytes; hotlinked URLs can fail. Prefer the upload-URL endpoint when unsure.

Clone a voice from an audio sample and generate speech. 
* Each character costs 0.1 credits. 
* The cost is rounded up to the nearest whole number Before choosing settings, read get_account_info and the current parameter constraints. A listed model, resolution, duration or count is not necessarily available together or on this account. Preserve explicit requirements and all supplied inputs; explain a genuine block instead of submitting an incompatible request. Account balance alone does not prove a request is affordable. Use only a recording of your own voice or a voice you have permission to clone. Do not impersonate or deceive others.

assets.description: Provide the assets for voice cloning.

audio_file_path.description:
The audio used to clone the voice. This value is either
- a direct URL to the file. The URL path must end in a supported file extension.
- `file_path` field from the response of the [upload urls API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls).

See the [file upload guide](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/files/generate-asset-upload-urls#input-file) for details.

name.description: Give your audio a custom name for easy identification.

language.description: Spoken language. Use a canonical lowercase language name, or auto to detect the language from the text. Defaults to auto.

prompt.description: Text used to generate speech from the cloned voice. The character limit is 5000 characters.
prompt.example: Hello, this is my cloned voice.

speed.description: Speech speed multiplier, from 0.75 to 1.30 inclusive. Defaults to 1 (normal speed).

name: ai_voice_cloner_create_audio

credits_charged.description:
The amount of credits deducted from your account to generate the audio. We charge credits right when the request is made. 

If an error occurred while generating the audio, credits will be refunded and this field will be updated to include the refund.

id.description: Unique ID of the audio. Use it with the [Get audio Project API](https://docs.magichour.ai/api-reference/audio-projects/get-audio-details) to fetch status and downloads.

title: AI Voice Cloner
